
CLEAR-DEPENDENCIES
Remove all dependencies from a work unit

USAGE
  fspec clear-dependencies <workUnitId> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID

OPTIONS
  --force
    Skip confirmation

EXAMPLES
  1. Clear all dependencies
  $ fspec clear-dependencies AUTH-001
  ✓ Cleared all dependencies from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-dependency
  fspec remove-dependency

NOTES
  • Removes all relationship types
  • Requires confirmation unless --force is used
